sources.snippet: MNN-Pocket-0.3B is intended for on-device assistants, data extraction, and lightweight agentic pipelines. Like other sub-billion-parameter models, it is not recommended for reasoning-heavy workloads such as advanced mathematics or long-horizon code generation.
